comments.body: That's a given for all Aide disaster prevention skills, really. But it has been said that Aide trait points = percentage of success (with 100 points being 99.9%) in the skill triggering, and it certainly seems to hold true with my own experiences. 100 Crew skill may help in conjunction with it, but I get fires quite frequently when I sail through the disaster-triggering zones and don't have this skill active, even with 100 Crew skill.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
Actually every aide skill gives 100 % prevention theoretical if the trait is at 100S on that specific prevention skill. However what most do not realise is that aide (s) are like sailors in your ship that needs money, food and water.

If you sail without ANY food/water then not only the prestige decreases from sailors, but also from your aide (s) that accompany you. Prevention/Action of your aide won't work then including this one. This is a common mistake that traders makes by loading their cargo full with burnable trade good while sailing without supply.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Well, I can only attest to the fact that very rarely, despite having ample provisions and money on hand, and an Aide in the correct job with maxed traits in all fields, disasters have sometimes still happened despite an Aide prevention skill being active.

Make of that what you will, and be careful not to sail without sufficient money/supplies, and to keep a few "red herring" trade goods in your cargo hold to act as a fire-magnet (fish caught with Fishing are my favorites for this), just in case.

comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
Something that helps with preventing any of the sailing disasters is equip a figurehead with a high(7-8) Crisis Protection rating(the first of the 4 figurehead stats). Another thing that helps is keep sailor fatigue to a minimum, which is helped by the second stat a figurehead has, Fatigue Relief. That's why the Quetzalcotl figurehead is great for adventure and trade, it's stats are 7/7/0/0, and since they are player made, sell for 5m-ish in stores and bazaars.
